subject: Designer / Draftsperson application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Transform Formwork team,

I'm applying for the Designer / Draftsperson role advertised on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your advert asks for someone who updates drawings to reflect site conditions and works closely with the site team, which suits me because on site I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against the work to cut down on errors and rework. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid role, I have not yet drawn formwork, and I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
